examples.title: Basic

examples.title: Simple list
examples.description: A panel with one column of links, for shorter menus.

a11y: It's a nav landmark with a list of links and disclosure buttons, so links stay links and Tab reaches every one in order.
Each button says whether its panel is open (aria-expanded). Enter or Space opens and closes it; Down Arrow opens it on the first link.
Left and Right Arrow move between the top-level items; Up and Down Arrow move between the links in an open panel.
Escape closes the panel and puts focus back on its button. Moving focus or the pointer away closes it too, unless it was opened with a click.
Mark the link to the current page with aria-current="page".
